remarks: Welcome to 247 Connecticut Ave #2. Second floor open concept two bedroom apartment with all of your needs. Unit has high ceillings and plenty of space for comfort. Many closets/cabinets - ample storage space. Includes 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, living room and kitchen & dining area. Sky lights and plenty of windows keep space light & bright. Washer/Dryer in unit & Assigned Parking (2 spaces) in rear lot for convenience. Prime location for commuters. Steps from I95 (Exit 14) & just minutes from South Norwalk Train Station, SONO - restaurants/shops/mall, Maritime Aquarium & all that RT 1 has to off! Good credit, proof of income & references are a MUST. No tenant supplied background/credit checks. NO PETS/NO SMOKING.
